title: FOREST STREAM BACKGROUND (far+mid+near) - water lightness by depth
notes: One hue: leaf green (OKLab hue 150), chroma 0.08-0.10 -
stronger than cs. L 0.74 at the surface, 0.68 mid,
0.50 low, 0.42 at the floor. Dark brown-green roots,
orange-brown leaf litter on the floor (the only warm).
Today: fish highlights = water (+0.00), 45% of fish
pixels in the discord band (yellow-olive / gold).
! Fish must bracket the water: lit > water + 0.10,
! body darks < water - 0.12; bottom fish lean light.
wheel: teal ring = ANALOGOUS (within 45 deg): moss olive, green,
pool teal, turquoise - bodies that belong to the stream.
red ring = DISCORD (45-110 deg): yellow, gold, ochre, blue.
Where 45% of fs fish sit today (mustard / olive-gold).
amber ring = COMPLEMENT (over 110 deg): copper, rust, brick,
rose. Muted on bodies (they echo roots and leaf litter),
saturated as accents: red fins, breeding colours.
Neutral pearl / charcoal fits anywhere (darters, silvers).
Chroma: bodies at half the water's (0.03-0.06); accents 0.10-0.15.
